purpose: Decline to choose between two possible descriptions.
keywords: Plain expression + とも … + とも + 言えない / つかない
I cannot say whether I agree or disagree.
He made a sound that was neither clearly laughter nor crying.
The result cannot clearly be judged a success or a failure.
formation: Plain expression + とも … + とも + 言えない / つかない
restrictions: Usually pairs alternative or opposing labels.
mistake: The negative predicate withholds judgment; it does not affirm both labels.
